content: We need to find a template that when applied retrosynthetically to the given molecule (target) reproduces the Peterson reaction: forward reaction forms C=C double bond, breaks C-Si and C-O bonds, forms C=C. So retrosynthetic step: break C=C double bond to give beta-hydroxy silane (C-O and C-Si). So we need a template that matches target with functional groups: formed C-C double bond, broken ketones? Wait description: "ketones and trimethylsilyl groups are lost". Actually forward reaction: starting from beta-hydroxy silane (with SiMe3 and OH) eliminates to alkene, losing SiMe3 (as silane?) and carbonyl? Hmm Peterson: alpha-silyl carbanion adds to carbonyl to give beta-hydroxy silane, then elimination yields alkene, losing SiMe3 group as silanol? The description says ketones are lost (i.e., carbonyl broken) and trimethylsilyl groups lost. So forward: ketone + silyl carbanion -> beta-hydroxy silane -> alkene. So retrosynthetic: alkene -> beta-hydroxy silane (with SiMe3) and ketone? Actually we need to break C=C to give carbonyl and SiMe3 attached carbon? The template likely involves breaking C=C double bond, forming C=O (ketone) and C-Si (trimethylsilyl). So functional groups formed in forward: C-C double bond; broken: ketone, trimethylsilyl. So for retrosynthesis, we need template where functional_groups_broken includes "C-C double bonds" (since forward forms it) and functional_groups_formed includes "ketones" and "trimethylsilyl". Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with target SMILES: C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2. Provide criteria: functional_groups_broken=["C-C double bonds"], functional_groups_formed=["ketones","trimethylsilyl"]. Let's call search.
